messages:
Riley Moore: Heads-up: planning a docs cleanup next week to consolidate quickstarts and move language samples into a single canonical samples repo. Goal: reduce drift and make maintenance faster.
Evan Brooks: Sounds good. Does this affect the SDK README quickstarts?
Riley Moore: Yes — READMEs will keep a one-line quickstart + link to the canonical sample in samples.redwood.dev. Well add a generated short snippet for the README and point people to the full runnable example.
Nora Patel: Will we provide a tiny CLI to scaffold the quickstart so users can run locally? That would cut down on copy/paste errors.
Riley Moore: Exactly. Nora is building `redwood-samples init --lang js` which will create the minimal files and env examples. Itll be published as a tiny npm/pip bin.
DocBot: Note: draft PR #4201 created: move /docs/quickstarts/js to /samples/quickstarts/js and add README shims.
Evan Brooks: Migration plan? I want a smooth path for embedded snippets used in blog posts or partner docs.
Riley Moore: Two-step: 1) Sync period (2 weeks): we create symlinked READMEs and keep old content but mark them as deprecated. 2) Redirect phase: replace full examples with a 3-5 line minimal snippet + link. We'll keep copies for internal partners.
Sam Park: Will this break the code search or snippets index? We rely on literal paths in some integrations.
InfraBot: Infra note: we'll add rewrite rules in the docs CDN to preserve old URLs for 90 days and add 301s after that. Also updating the snippets index to reference canonical sample IDs rather than paths.
Priya Kapoor: Legal check: moving examples into a samples repo means we need a clear license header and contributor CLA note. I can provide a template header for each sample.
Nora Patel: For translations/localization: should we duplicate minimal snippets per locale or keep a single canonical snippet and translate surrounding prose?
Riley Moore: Keep one canonical code snippet (EN) and translate prose. If a localized team needs localized code comments, they can open a samples PR and tag `samples-l10n`.
Evan Brooks: What about tests? We want runnable CI checks for the samples.
Riley Moore: Samples repo will have per-language smoke tests that run in GitHub Actions. Failure reporting will surface as docs CI checks too. DocBot will open automated fix PRs for trivial issues.
DocBot: Action: sample smoke test GH workflow added in PR #4207.
Sam Park: Any deprecation warnings in the docs while we migrate?
Riley Moore: Yes — well add a short deprecation banner on the old quickstart pages pointing to the canonical samples. Banner shows for 14 days during sync period.
Priya Kapoor: Confirmed license header template posted to legal-policy/samples-license.md.
Nora Patel: ETA on CLI/binary publish?
Riley Moore: Nora aims to publish beta packages by EOD Fri, full rollout next week. Well run a short training drop-in for SDK owners on Tue.
Evan Brooks: Fine by me. Ill update our SDK README generator to use the new CLI link instead of inlining full examples.
DocBot: Reminder set: Tue 2024-07-02 16:00 UTC  "Samples migration sync + SDK owners" (channel #docs, invitees: SDK owners).
Riley Moore: Thanks all  please review the draft PRs in the docs repo and ping if you need an exemption for partner content.
